PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY:

Senior Business Analyst and Team Lead with 14+ years of experience in BFSI, Capital Markets, and Investment Banking domains. Experienced in program-level delivery, leading cross-functional Agile teams, and managing global stakeholders at Director and MD level across US, UK, and APAC geographies. Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end business transformation programs, define solution strategy, and align technology roadmaps to business objectives. Expertise across the full BA lifecycle — Requirements Gathering, Gap Analysis, AS-IS TO-BE Analysis, Solution Scoping, UAT Management, and Traceability Matrix. Known for translating complex business problems into clear, actionable solutions that development teams can build, stakeholders can trust, and organizations can scale.

Certification/Training:

ITIL 4 Foundation by Peoplecert Certified (Valid-Sept-2028).

Microsoft Certified in Azure Fundaments-AZ 900 (Jan-2025).

PSPO1 (Professional Scrum Product Owner) Certified (Jun 2023).

PSM1 (Professional Scrum Master) Certified (Jan 2023).

IIBA CPAB trained (Business Analyst) by Trainsmart academy (Oct 2022)

Training on Scum fundaments by scrum study (Jun 2020)

Business Analysis Fundaments Crash Course by Udemy (Jan 2020)

NISM Certification(expired) Mutual Funds and NCFM (expired) NSDL Depository Operations Module.

III Licentiate-Life insurance (Operations) by III-insurance institute of India.

Training on Power BI by skill nations.

Domain: BFSI, Capital market, Investment Banking.

Skills & Tools: SDLC, Use Cases, User Stories, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Problem Solving, Wireframing JIRA, MS SharePoint, MS Visio,SQL Balsamiq, GTM(CSM), Custody Portals, Trade life Cycle

Achievements:

State Street Corporate Services: Best Team Leader (2023 JAS)- Awarded for leading a cross-functional team to the successful deployment of project, resulting in improved delivery timelines and stakeholder satisfaction.

State Street Corporate Services: -Consistently exceeded annual KPIs, earning the "Exceptional Performer" rating for three years through the successful delivery of complex process

WORK EXPERIENCE

State Street Corporate Services Private LTD

March 2019 – February 2025 -Coimbatore, Chennai, Pune.

(Mar _19 To Mar_24 SSHCL, Apr_24 To Feb_25 SS)

Role -Business Analyst Designation -Senior Associate/TL

Domain: Middle Office Trade Settlements (Fails Management, KPI, Dashboards) | Capital Markets | Investment Banking (Trade Lifecycle, Trade Capture, Transaction Reconciliation and Reporting, IBOR (Investment Book of Records) exposure to Products – Equity, Bond, FX, Derivatives (Swaps, Options, Future), Securities Lending & Borrowing.

Led end-to-end Business Analysis for Middle Office Trade Settlements Portal migration programs, managing requirements from discovery through UAT and production deployment.

Conducted AS-IS discovery sessions and stakeholder interviews with onshore US/UK business sponsors at Director and MD level to capture High-Level Business Requirements and solution gaps.

Mapped Business Requirements to existing service offerings and worked with Data and Technical Architects to identify feasible solution options and define TO-BE state.

Performed requirement prioritization using Moscow approach and Value/Effort analysis to recommend phasing of proposed solutions aligned to business priorities.

Collaborated with UI/UX teams to develop solution prototypes and led solution demonstrations and presentations for onshore prospects and business stakeholders.

Acted as a primary liaison between onshore Agile teams and offshore stakeholders for new product introductions, change requests, and issue resolution — ensuring zero SLA breaches.

Documented Solution Scope, Findings, Recommendations, Functionality Gaps, and New Requirements in conjunction with Technical Leads.

Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives by analyzing current-state business processes, defining future-state operating models, and supporting business transformation programs.

Performed AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify process gaps, improvement opportunities, and operating model enhancements across business functions.



Collaborated with business stakeholders, SMEs, Product Owners, and technology teams to define future-state business processes and transformation roadmaps.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops to gather business requirements, validate future-state process designs, and obtain sign-off on transformation initiatives.

Developed Process Architecture documentation, including end-to-end process flows, workflow diagrams, business rules, and operating procedures.

Performed Business Capability Assessment to identify functional ownership, process dependencies, and opportunities for process standardization and automation.

Supported Business Capability Mapping by documenting business functions, process ownership, and interactions between business and technology teams.

Conducted Value Stream Analysis to identify bottlenecks, eliminate non-value-added activities, and improve operational efficiency.

Supported Client/Customer Journey Mapping by analyzing end-to-end business processes, identifying pain points, and recommending process improvements to enhance user experience.

Worked closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned with business objectives.

Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to ensure business requirements and future-state operating processes were implemented successfully.

Supported business transformation initiatives through process standardization, governance improvements, impact analysis, change management, and UAT coordination.

Led complete Project Documentation lifecycle from Requirements to UAT, including Traceability Matrix, Test Scenarios, and Sign-Off management.

Conducted Knowledge Transfer sessions and led User Training delivery for end users across multiple geographies.



Developed Story-boarding and Value Proposition decks for C-suite and MD-level governance reviews and steering committee presentations.

Managed team of Business Analysts and Associates — responsible for goal setting, performance appraisals, and delivery oversight

Deutsche Bank Group (DBOI Global Services Ltd) August 2017 – June 2018-Pune

Role -Business Analyst Designation -Associate

Domain: Change Management, Production Management | STEER Project | Investment Banking Operations(Custodian,Brokers, Asset Management)

Led Business Requirements Gathering, Elicitation, and Documentation for the STEER Change Management Program — a large-scale operational transformation initiative.

Conducted AS-IS Analysis with customer stakeholders for Business Process and Application Feature review, and defined TO-BE state in collaboration with Technical Teams.

Performed Gap Analysis and Feasibility Studies to define scope and complexity of change, ensuring alignment between business expectations and technical delivery.

Created comprehensive User, Technical, and Business Documentation for Customer, QA, and Technical teams — ensuring zero ambiguity in solution delivery.

Led Solution Prototype creation and Feature Demonstrations during Pre and Post Development phases, procuring customer sign-off on final deliverables.

Managed Knowledge Portal — publishing periodic bulletins and reports on new content to keep stakeholders aligned throughout the change program.

Investigated abnormal variances including day-on-day movements, coordinating with onshore teams and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve open items within agreed TAT.

Bajaj Allianz Financial Distributors LTD. November 2012 –May 2016-Pune

Role -Business Analyst Designation -Assistant Manager

Domain: Insurance | Mutual Funds | BFSI Operations | Application Training

Conducted Application Analysis, User Profile Analysis, and User Task Analysis to define training requirements aligned to application design and release schedules.

Liaised with Business, Development, and QA teams to gather information and participated in Requirement and Solution Design workshops during Application Design phase.

Managed complete Review Cycle with business and customers, procuring sign-off on final training deliverables and compliance audit documentation.

Handled Compliance and Audit support, Product Training, Agents Licensing (fresh and renewals), Insurance Policy servicing, and Brokerage Reconciliation for Mutual Funds and Insurance.

IDBI Asset Management Ltd

(on deputation)- (Computer Age Management Services Pvt Ltd (CAMS)-April 10-March 12 IDBI Intech April 12- Oct 2012) April 2010 – October 2012-Pune

Senior Processing Officer (CSE) &

Religare Finvest Ltd June 2007 – May 2009 Executive-Operations

Domain: Mutual Funds | Depository Operations | KYC | Retail & Corporate Clients Front Office Operations | Capital Markets | Demat | IPO |

Settlements

Managed end-to-end transaction processing for Mutual Funds (Liquid, Debt, Equity) — KYC processing for Retail and Corporate clients including documentation, verification, system upload, and CDSL follow-ups.

Handled client servicing, query resolution within TAT, commission management, and brokerage reconciliation for agents.

Handled front office and operations for Mutual Funds, Demat account opening, Insurance, and query resolution for IPO, Corporate Actions, Dematerialization, Pay-In/Pay-Out, Settlements, and Transmission.

Managed client serving, promotions event management, and product training — ensuring 100% query resolution within TAT

Information Technology Diploma- S.S.V.P.S Polytechnic Dhule-2003-2005

Engineering Diploma in Computers Engineering -M.I.T.'s Sri Savitribai Phule Polytechnic Pune-2000-2003

H.S.C-Electronics Science- Jai Hind (Sr.) College, & S.S.C- Jai Hind School.
